event.description:
The Fall 2026 Airport Ground Transportation Association (AGTA) Conference takes place October 11–14, 2026, at the Beacon Grand, A Union Square Hotel in San Francisco. The annual fall event brings together airport operators, transportation providers, and technology innovators to share case studies and operational strategies to improve and enhance the customer experience. The event theme, “Gateway to Tomorrow: How Innovative Technology is Transforming Airport Ground Transportation,” centers around AI curb management, autonomous vehicles, and fleet electrification.

Please visit AGTA for additional information.
